badge: Illustrative scenario / assumptions — not GWD accounting or forecast
disclaimer: All figures, prices, volumes and allocations in this simulator are deterministic illustrative inputs. They do not represent actual GWD revenue, costs, budgets, forecasts, valuations or financial advice.

centreDefinitions.label: Cost Centre
centreDefinitions.description: Shared capabilities (Strategy, Finance, People & Agent Ops, AI Platform, Legal, Marketing, Product, Security) measured on cost discipline, service quality and transparent allocation to business units.

centreDefinitions.label: Profit Centre Candidate
centreDefinitions.description: Business units (GWD Academy, Media Factory & Growth, Sales & Customer Operations) that become profit centres only once real offers, attributable revenue, direct delivery costs and management accountability exist.

centreDefinitions.label: Investment / Innovation Centre Candidate
centreDefinitions.description: Time-boxed venture and lab portfolios (GWD Ventures & Venture Studio and Layer 5 Labs) measured on stage-gated capital allocation, validated hypotheses and learning milestones rather than immediate operating margin.

presets.title: Scenario A — Executive Learning Cohort (Illustrative)
presets.description: Hypothetical two-market digital learning cohort evaluating whether participant tuition covers direct instructional/platform delivery and allocated shared services.
exclusions: Excludes corporate tax, statutory audit fees, historical sunk R&D and capital fundraising.

presets.title: Scenario B — Media & Growth Program (Illustrative)
presets.description: Hypothetical digital media and campaign production package modelling client retainers against production delivery and shared brand/platform overhead.
exclusions: Excludes third-party pass-through ad media spend billed directly to clients.

presets.title: Scenario C — Managed Customer Operations (Illustrative)
presets.description: Hypothetical managed commercial and customer-success workflow evaluating recurring service accounts against human-supervised delivery and security/platform allocations.
exclusions: Excludes enterprise custom integration hardware or external legal counsel retainers.

presets.title: Scenario D — Venture & Lab Validation Sprint (Illustrative)
presets.description: Hypothetical pre-revenue venture and lab experimentation sprint illustrating stage-gated R&D and shared-service consumption with zero assumed commercial revenue.
exclusions: No valuation, equity return, IRR or future revenue projection is assumed or implied.
